units.passage: If AI was used, one should also submit a chatlog. Further guidance provided in class Should you use an AI tool to help you do your homework? You will have the ability to evaluate the output only really if you try to do it yourself first and gain that experience. While AI use is not prohibited in this course, you will be expected to understand the code that you submit to get full credit on the assignment. You need to understand the code to also do well on the exams. Before you use the internet/gen AI Try to do the assignment first with basic concepts and learning from errors. Use internet/generative AI to figure out errors only if you need it Acknowledge that what you used in the header comments of your code Make sure you understand what you have used from these outside sources.
units.why: ME 208: 'You will have the ability to evaluate the output only really if you try to do it yourself first' gives the reason to try the work first, P90 sequencing.

units.passage: With this in mind, for writing assignments for this course, you are allowed to use built-in spellcheck, grammar check, or Grammarly (without the generative AI feature) after you have already brainstormed and drafted your work
units.why: English HNRS 190: 'after you have already brainstormed and drafted your work' makes the allowed tools come after the student's own draft, P90.
units.fit_note: Sequencing applies to spellcheck and grammar tools, not generative AI.

units.passage: However, after formulating your ideas, you may use these tools for writing and revising the final product.
units.why: Sample: 'after formulating your ideas, you may use these tools for writing and revising the final product'. Use is allowed only after doing the thinking yourself, P90 (P91 also fits, but the sequencing is the distinctive rule).
units.fit_note: Also permits editing and writing support (P91).

units.passage: Summarize sources, readings, transcripts, or datasets after you have already engaged the materials yourself;
units.why: Conditionally permitted: 'Summarize sources, readings, transcripts, or datasets after you have already engaged the materials yourself'; do the work first, P90.

units.passage: Summarize or analyze assigned materials without reading, viewing, listening to, or otherwise engaging
units.why: Not permitted: 'Summarize or analyze assigned materials without reading ... those materials yourself'; do the work yourself first, P90.
units.fit_note: Frames the rule as a ban on summarising unread material, rather than as an order of work.

units.passage: Second Drafts: You may use Generative AI to help you revise your writing or work on a second draft, but you are expected to write the first draft yourself.
units.why: "You are expected to write the first draft yourself" sets a do-it-yourself-first sequence (P90).

units.passage: Start with your own ideas before turning to AI.
units.why: "Start with your own ideas before turning to AI" is a sequencing rule, P90.

units.passage: Asking AI to outline or structure your assignment before you have developed your own approach
units.why: Not permitted: asking AI to outline "before you have developed your own approach"; do the work first, then use AI, P90.

units.passage: Asking AI to outline, structure, or generate solutions before you have developed your own approach.
units.why: Inappropriate: asking AI first "before you have developed your own approach", the do-it-yourself-first sequencing rule, P90.

units.passage: This is conditional upon having made a genuine attempt to address the problem independently within your group.
units.why: "conditional upon having made a genuine attempt to address the problem independently within your group" sequences work: try first, then AI, P90.
